# YOUNITED Gourmet Snacking

> Gourmet taste. Real nutrition. Finally united. YOUNITED makes protein candy bars, cereal cups, real cheese puffs and gourmet spreads that taste like a treat first and read like a nutrition label second. Four families, thirteen flavours, made in the EU. We unite for better.

## The range
- [Four families. One label.](https://younitedsnacks.com/#range): 4 families, 13 flavours, made in the EU. Chocolate, crunch, breakfast and a little something for 3pm.
- [Protein Candy Bars](https://younitedsnacks.com/#family-bars): a real candy-bar experience with a gooey centre, nut crunch and chocolate coat. 15 g protein, 4 g fibre, 0 g added sugar and ≤199 kcal per serving. Flavours: Pistachio & White Chocolate, Hazelnut & Milk Chocolate, Peanut & Caramel.
- [Protein Cereal Cups](https://younitedsnacks.com/#family-cereal): breakfast in a cup, sweetened with monk fruit; add milk and it's ready. 15 g protein and 5 g fibre per serving. Flavours: Apple & Cinnamon, Tropical Fruit, Chocolate.
- [Real Cheese Puffs](https://younitedsnacks.com/#family-puffs): made with real cheese, 15 g protein per serving. Flavours: Korean-Style Kimchi, Piedmont-Style Truffle, Belgian Chocolate (a cheese puff coated in Belgian chocolate), Dutch-Style Smoked.
- [Gourmet Spreads](https://younitedsnacks.com/#family-spreads): single-serve squeeze packs for toast, yoghurt or straight from the sachet. Up to 9 g protein and 0 g added sugar. Flavours: Pistachio & White Chocolate, Peanut & Caramel, Hazelnut & White Chocolate.
- Nutrition values are formulation targets per serving and may vary by product and market.

## Our thinking
- [Nutrition sells the first bar. Taste sells forever.](https://younitedsnacks.com/#manifesto) We build snacks with one rule: they have to taste like a treat first. Then we make the nutrition work, without losing the flavour and texture that make you reach for another.
- [Real cheese. Belgian chocolate. Yes, together.](https://younitedsnacks.com/#spotlight) A crisp cheese centre with a Belgian chocolate coat.

## Our story
- [Made in the EU. Built for your market.](https://younitedsnacks.com/#made) YOUNITED works with specialist producers in the EU. Product development, brand and distribution stay in-house as the range is built for retailers and distributors across markets.
- [Kadir Demir](https://younitedsnacks.com/#founder), co-founder, leads product design and development at YOUNITED. His experience spans Muscle Cheff, Smarter Snacks and Bite & More; his portfolio of 45 product creations is at https://misterkd.com/#creations

## Partner with us
- [Bring YOUNITED to your shelves](https://younitedsnacks.com/#partner): for distributors, retailers and food-service partners building their next range. Range: 4 families, 13 flavours. Production: specialist producers in the EU. Development: in-house. Formats, pricing and minimums on request.
- Enquiries (distributor, retailer, food service, investor, press, consumer) go to the YOUNITED team by email through the form on the page.
- [Privacy notice](https://younitedsnacks.com/privacy.html): what happens to the details sent with an enquiry.
